propertyFacts.label: Fluorescence intensity at −30 °C relative to 0 °C
propertyFacts.scope: 0 °C baseline = 100%; 30% ethanol dispersion. Main p.1 abstract states fluorescence increases about 62–82% from 0 to −30 °C. bindings.caption: Use 30% volume fraction ethanol in the aqueous time-indexed CdTe dispersion, as selected in Section 3.3. Absolute volumes are unreported. Conceptual stage diagram. Mix aqueous QD dispersion and ethanol; no phase separation is implied.

bindings.caption: Characterize at 0, −5, −10, −15, −20, −25 and −30 °C. Section 2.3 gives a general 12 h hold before next-day measurements; separate Figure 4 hold times are not restated. Figure 4 curve a shows absorption only at −30 °C; b–h are the seven fluorescence temperatures. Conceptual stage diagram. Temperature-dependent spectra; setpoints are analytical conditions, not growth temperatures.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
